summary: Section 3 (and the section 2 loop at :94-100) runs `cosign verify` only against `ghcr.io/${OWNER}/:${TAG#v}`, by tag. No `cosign verify` on the page takes a digest (:73, :84, :96, :214, :237, :242, :275, :350, :355, :543); the only digest-form verifier is `gh attestation verify ...@sha256:` (:419, section 4). The check therefore examines whatever the moved tag names NOW, never the digest the customer holds. Three cases: (1) an unsigned hand-pushed tag makes the check fail, so the customer drops a genuine digest; (2) a tag moved A->X->A after the customer pulled X lets the check pass, so the customer keeps X; (3) a deleted tag gives MANIFEST_UNKNOWN, a false stop. Minimal fix: give section 3's identity and issuer flags against `ghcr.io/${OWNER}/@sha256:` inline (or in section 3 itself so every site resolves to it), and word bullet 1 as verifying the digest itself against that release's identity.
classification_rationale: CLASS: VARIANT of G8P10-security-guardian-1; its fix (the '(section 3)' cross-reference) introduced it.
